protocols.title: Argireline topical application protocol — source reference
protocols.purpose: Topical cosmetic application schedule and formulation references from the cited sources
protocols.evidenceNotes: Peptides.org describes topical application to intact skin twice daily for at least 30 days; its sample reference uses a 10% emulsion and reports about 2 mg/cm². Dosage Peptide separately describes 5–10% of its supplied aqueous solution in a leave-on product, once or twice daily. The two formulations are source-specific and should not be treated as interchangeable or as a validated medical regimen.

schedule.description: Apply a thin layer to intact target skin twice daily for at least 30 days, as described by Peptides.org. Its sample reference is a 10% emulsion at about 2 mg/cm²; these percentage and mass-per-area units are retained in notes, not represented as a structured dose.

regimen.notes: Peptides.org sample reference: 10% emulsion, about 2 mg/cm², applied twice daily to intact target skin for 30 days or until desired outcome. The article's quick chart says at least 30 days. Dosage Peptide separately describes 5–10% of its supplied aqueous Argireline solution in a leave-on product once or twice daily; this is a different formulation reference. Dose remains null because the schema cannot encode percent concentration or mg/cm².
